Continued in #47308, which incorporates these overlap controls together with mixed-prefill reservation and additional scheduler-mode validation. The original proposal and focused tests are retained here for review history.

## Motivation

Two consecutive prefill batches can overlap their temporary workspaces even when each batch fits on its own. Add two opt-in limits: combined new tokens, and minimum free GPU memory across the TP group. Both default to disabled; decode overlap is unchanged.

The memory probe keeps allocator caches intact. Attention DP > 1 is rejected at startup when either limit is enabled, since rank-local prefill decisions need a different consensus protocol. The K3 cookbook documents the knobs and throughput tradeoff.

## Test Plan

Focused CPU regressions cover the token boundary, disabled defaults, decode/first-batch behavior, TP-minimum memory probe and attention-DP startup rejection. The actual scheduler methods were exercised against the published runtime context; only the external memory probe was replaced. These checks pass. Full distributed scheduling and model throughput remain to be validated in upstream CI.

Ruff/isort formatting and focused lint checks pass. No production service changes.

Prepared with Codex assistance.

files.patch:
@@ -478,3 +478,19 @@ Decisions the preset already makes:
 <Note>
 No preset has a full serving round on final weights; the constants derive from measured single- and dual-node rounds plus a 64-GPU sweep. Validate throughput and accuracy on your workload before committing a fleet.
 </Note>
+## Limit consecutive prefill overlap
+
+Two overlapping prefill batches can keep their temporary workspaces live at the
+same time. Optional resource budgets can defer the next batch until the previous
+one finishes:
+
+| Environment variable | Meaning | Default |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET` | Maximum combined new-token count of consecutive prefill batches | `0` (disabled) |
+| `SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB` | Minimum free GPU memory across the TP group before overlapping consecutive prefill batches | `0` (disabled) |
+
+These limits leave decode overlap unchanged and do not clear allocator caches.
+They currently require attention DP size 1; enabling them with attention DP is
+rejected at startup. They complement the per-batch `--max-prefill-tokens` limit
+and can reduce overlap, so measure throughput for your workload before enabling
+them.

@@ -685,6 +685,9 @@ class Envs:
     # Overlap scheduler and pipeline parallelism
     # ===================================================================
     SGLANG_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_PREFILL_OVERLAP = EnvBool(False)
+    # Optional consecutive-prefill resource limits; non-positive disables each.
+    SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET = EnvInt(0)
+    SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB = EnvFloat(0.0)
     # Force delay_sample_func for all overlap decode (not just grammar mode),
     # allowing CPU result processing to overlap with subsequent forward computation
     # and reducing the impact of sampling overhead on the critical path.

@@ -1642,6 +1642,13 @@ def init_disaggregation(self):
             )
 
     def init_overlap(self):
+        if (
+            envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.get() > 0
+            or envs.SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB.get() > 0
+        ) and get_parallel().attn_dp_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Prefill overlap resource budgets currently require attention DP size 1"
+            )
         self.device_module = torch.get_device_module(self.device)
 
         # FutureMap is always-on: input_ids relay used in both modes.
@@ -2114,6 +2121,27 @@ def is_disable_overlap_for_batch(
             and last_batch_is_extend
         )
 
+        if batch_is_extend and last_batch_is_extend:
+            token_budget = envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.get()
+            if token_budget > 0:
+                disable_overlap_for_batch |= (
+                    batch.extend_num_tokens + last_batch.extend_num_tokens
+                    > token_budget
+                )
+            min_free_gb = envs.SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB.get()
+            if min_free_gb > 0:
+                # DP>1 is rejected at initialization: its rank-local prefill
+                # counts need a different consensus protocol. All ranks in this
+                # TP/CP group query the same minimum without clearing caches.
+                free_gb = get_available_gpu_memory(
+                    self.device,
+                    get_device().gpu_id,
+                    distributed=True,
+                    empty_cache=False,
+                    cpu_group=self.tp_cpu_group,
+                )
+                disable_overlap_for_batch |= free_gb < min_free_gb
+
         # Sync so the FSM advance lands before the next batch's bitmask. Permanent
         # path for host-draft algorithms, not a pending migration.
         need_grammar_sync = (

@@ -2,13 +2,17 @@
 
 import unittest
 from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
 
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
-from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
 
 maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
 
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_device, publish, reset_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
@@ -62,5 +66,104 @@ def test_running_batch_shrinking_below_threshold_ends_interval(self):
         self.assertEqual(scheduler._prefill_decode_interval_remaining, 0)
 
 
+class TestPrefillOverlapBudgets(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", device="cpu"), role="scheduler")
+
+    def _scheduler(self):
+        scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+        scheduler.require_mlp_sync = False
+        scheduler.result_queue = []
+        scheduler.device = "cuda"
+        scheduler.tp_cpu_group = object()
+        return scheduler
+
+    def _batch(self, tokens, *, prefill=True):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            extend_num_tokens=tokens,
+            forward_mode=SimpleNamespace(
+                is_extend=lambda: prefill, is_decode=lambda: not prefill
+            ),
+            is_extend_in_batch=prefill,
+            spec_algorithm=SimpleNamespace(is_none=lambda: True),
+        )
+
+    def test_combined_prefill_budget_and_disabled_default(self):
+        scheduler = self._scheduler()
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_PREFILL_OVERLAP.override(False),
+            envs.SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB.override(0),
+        ):
+            for budget, tokens, expected in [
+                (0, 80, False),
+                (128, 64, False),
+                (128, 65, True),
+            ]:
+                with (
+                    self.subTest(budget=budget, tokens=tokens),
+                    envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.override(budget),
+                ):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        scheduler.is_disable_overlap_for_batch(
+                            self._batch(tokens), self._batch(tokens)
+                        ),
+                        expected,
+                    )
+            with envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.override(1):
+                self.assertFalse(
+                    scheduler.is_disable_overlap_for_batch(
+                        self._batch(80, prefill=False), self._batch(80)
+                    )
+                )
+                self.assertFalse(
+                    scheduler.is_disable_overlap_for_batch(self._batch(80), None)
+                )
+
+    def test_free_memory_uses_tp_minimum_without_emptying_allocator(self):
+        scheduler = self._scheduler()
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_PREFILL_OVERLAP.override(False),
+            envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.override(0),
+            envs.SGLANG_PREFILL_OVERLAP_MIN_FREE_GB.override(2),
+            get_device().override(gpu_id=0),
+        ):
+            for free_gb, expected in [(1.5, True), (2, False), (3, False)]:
+
+                def probe(device, gpu_id, *, distributed, empty_cache, cpu_group):
+                    self.assertTrue(distributed)
+                    self.assertFalse(empty_cache)
+                    self.assertIs(cpu_group, scheduler.tp_cpu_group)
+                    return free_gb
+
+                with patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler.get_available_gpu_memory",
+                    side_effect=probe,
+                ):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        scheduler.is_disable_overlap_for_batch(
+                            self._batch(8), self._batch(8)
+                        ),
+                        expected,
+                    )
+
+    def test_attention_dp_is_rejected_before_resource_collectives(self):
+        publish(
+            ServerArgs(
+                model_path="dummy",
+                device="cpu",
+                tp_size=2,
+                dp_size=2,
+                enable_dp_attention=True,
+            ),
+            role="scheduler",
+        )
+        with envs.SGLANG_OVERLAP_PREFILL_TOKEN_BUDGET.override(128):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "attention DP size 1"):
+                Scheduler.init_overlap(Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
